The '''Carto Asteroid Belt''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

==History==
This [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] belt was mined by [[Drek Drednar]], who instructed his [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] to tow asteroids out of the belt and into major pace lanes. The asteroids created gravity shadows in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], so traveling ships would have to revert to realspace in their vicinity. The pirates would then attack the hapless ships.
